answer_1.quote: Machine unlearning has been used as a solution to address privacy and copyright issues in the text generation process of LLMs.

answer_2.quote: We propose five metrics to evaluate the basic unlearning and the superficial unlearning performance. We use exact match to calculate the score of all metrics.

answer_4.quote: We recruited crowd workers fluent in English through the university's online community and had them evaluate 800 generated natural language questions.
